summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A., a US-registered foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K for October 2026 containing its condensed interim financial statements for the six-month period ended June 30, 2026, with comparative December 31, 2025 figures in constant Argentine pesos. The report includes consolidated and separate statements of financial position, income, other comprehensive income, changes in shareholders' equity and cash flows, notes, exhibits, and review reports from auditors and the Supervisory Committee, signed by CFO Carmen Morillo Arroyo. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed; total assets stood at ARS 28.14 trillion as of June 30, 2026. Routine periodic reporting, no risk-arb angle.
